edenOSrules — ACTIVE CLEAN CANON
Version: 1.8
Date: 2026-09-24
Owner: Lucas Buzek
Status: ACTIVE CANON
Depends on: AppDevRules v1.8

SCOPE
Universal edenOS platform rules. Defines HOW entities participate in edenOS.
Does NOT enumerate Apps, Specialists, Helpers, Tiny Helpers, Agents or Products.
GrandMasterRegister lookup is user opt-in.

FOUNDATION
edenOS is the reusable platform/system layer of EDEN, not one giant application.
Apps retain domain ownership; edenOS provides common substrate for install, integration, discovery, capability exchange, provider relationships, interoperability and composition.
Hierarchy: EDEN -> AppDev -> edenOS -> Apps / Products / Workspaces / shared capabilities.

LOCAL-FIRST
Essential local operation/safety must not depend on Internet, cloud AI, remote server, HEIMDALL, another App or phone unless the task inherently requires it.
Real-time/safety-critical control remains local where appropriate.
Remote commands cannot bypass local safety.

BIFROST
BIFROST is “My Gateway to EDEN” — CONNECT & KEEP.
It owns/manages EDEN-generic connective state where required: canonical identity/metadata, representations/locations, relationships/provenance, registries, capability/provider/connection discovery and state, interoperability, persistent EDEN-specific connective state, package/install/update STATE/relationships, and Node discovery/registration/availability/relationships.
BIFROST FIRST does not mean mandatory.
Discovering/hosting/managing a capability does not make BIFROST its domain owner or mandatory execution gateway.
BIFROST works without AI and may be headless/API-capable.

DEPLOYMENT COMPOSITION & HANDOFF
BIFROST provides the common user-facing deployment composition/handoff interface across registered targets/Nodes where appropriate.
It may resolve:
- target Node/device/package
- release channel: OFFICIAL / DEVELOPMENT / EXPERIMENTAL
- authority: STANDARD / ADMIN
- audience: PRIVATE / FAMILY / FRIENDS / PUBLIC
- nested audience groups/users
- RECOMMENDED / CUSTOM profile
- inherited preferences and user-specific deltas
- target capabilities/providers/representations
BIFROST then opens/invokes the authoritative Apps/shared capabilities required to prepare, validate and perform the work.
BIFROST records deployment identity, relationships and resulting connective/package state; it does not acquire specialist domain ownership.
Deployment UI is capability-aware: simple controllers show only relevant operations/status; full composition appears only when the target/operation needs it.

NODES
A Node is a durable EDEN identity representing an authorized device/system capable of supplying and/or consuming capabilities.
Node != IP address != hostname != capability != service.
Addresses/interfaces/endpoints are mutable locations/representations.
Nodes may advertise/disclose capabilities.
BIFROST may discover/register Nodes, capabilities, availability and current representations.
A device may be consumer and provider. No mandatory master Node is implied.

NETWORK / EXPOSURE
DEVICE / LAN / PRIVATE REMOTE / PUBLIC are reachability/exposure policies, not Node identities and not the same as deployment audience.
LAN discovery and Internet publication are distinct.
Public exposure is explicit/selective.
Do not expose BIFROST administration/control plane publicly by default.
Reuse mature secure networking/authentication/TLS/provider capabilities.

CONTROL PLANE / DATA PLANE
BIFROST may establish identity, discovery, authorization, provider/location resolution and relationship state.
After authorized resolution, payload/runtime traffic may flow directly between consumer/shared capability/provider.
Do not force BIFROST to become a bandwidth/runtime bottleneck.

INFORMATION / DATA FABRIC
BIFROST may know canonical identity/object -> representations -> locations -> providers -> connections -> permissions -> availability -> provenance.
The authoritative payload need not live in BIFROST.
Access device, execution device, storage provider and presentation device may differ.
Stable logical identity should survive mutable network/provider locations where practical.

NATIVE / USER-INSTALLED / PROVIDER INTEGRATION
Suitable native, user-installed, network and provider software are first-class implementations and/or authoritative information stores.
Prefer native APIs, protocols, files, providers and handoffs.
Do not create an EDEN replacement merely because integration is possible.

CREDENTIALS / IDENTITY / AUTHORIZATION
Keychain is an Apple credential provider, not the EDEN credential architecture.
APP -> shared secure credential/authentication capability -> selected platform/provider adapter.
AUTHENTICATION != EDEN IDENTITY != AUTHORIZATION.
PROVIDER != INSTANCE/CONNECTION.
Do not indiscriminately replicate raw secrets across Nodes.
Changing/removing an external authentication/provider connection must not inherently destroy canonical EDEN identity or durable relationships.

HEIMDALL BOUNDARY
HEIMDALL owns Workspaces, information organization and human-facing composition/Custom Apps.
Historical HEIMDALL ownership of EDEN-generic canonical identity, global type/capability registry, generic provider state, physical locations, representations and platform-wide provenance is SUPERSEDED.

CONDUCTOR BOUNDARY
CONDUCTOR owns orchestration/coordination where required: intent, decomposition, capability/provider resolution, sequencing/dependencies, persistent/restartable coordination where applicable, retries/checkpoints/recovery and completion.
It does not take specialist domain ownership.
AOS as a separate current global execution owner is SUPERSEDED AS CURRENT OWNER; preserve its historical identity/provenance unless explicitly restored/redefined.

LCAS BOUNDARY
LCAS — Live Control, Activity & Status — is Chat UI/development interaction functionality only.
It is NOT an edenOS App, runtime service, Node service, mandatory monitoring dependency or system-wide operational-state authority.
Actual Apps/services/capabilities maintain/report their own state through their real contracts.
Older runtime/system ownership statements for LCAS are SUPERSEDED.

SPECIALIST OPERATIONS / EXPERIMENTAL BRIDGES
Specialist applications specialize and do.
Firmware/hardware engineering operations belong to the appropriate registered engineering owner.
Exact PROMETHEUS/DAEDALUS Mechanical/Electrical mapping remains UNRESOLVED until authoritative recovery/decision; do not guess.
Current direct BIFROST App update and direct device OTA paths may exist as EXPERIMENTAL BRIDGES for bootstrap/testing.
An Experimental Bridge never establishes permanent architectural ownership.

WEB / HOSTING
Web Access and Web Server/Hosting are shared capabilities.
BIFROST may discover/register/manage relationships, routes, availability and exposure policy without becoming mandatory runtime gateway.
Apps/sites retain domain/content ownership.

APP / CAPABILITY STATE
AVAILABLE != SELECTED != AUTHORIZED != INSTALLED != EXECUTING != DATA ACCESS.
Choosing/enabling an App does not automatically share provider data.
Connecting a provider does not expose everything.
A Web representation is not automatically a new App.

RELEASE / AUTHORITY / AUDIENCE
edenOS preserves three independent dimensions where applicable:
Release channel: OFFICIAL / DEVELOPMENT / EXPERIMENTAL.
Authority: STANDARD / ADMIN.
Deployment audience: PRIVATE / FAMILY / FRIENDS / PUBLIC.
Audience may contain nested groups/users and inherited/custom preferences.
These dimensions are not forced onto simple Nodes/controllers when irrelevant.

GRANDMASTERREGISTER OPT-IN
GrandMasterRegister is the authoritative catalogue/relationship registry for EDEN entities.
edenOSrules does not duplicate the entity list.
When user opt-in is enabled, edenOS/BIFROST may consult it for identity, type, ownership, capabilities and relationships.
The platform remains able to operate with locally registered/explicit capabilities when full GrandMasterRegister integration is not enabled.

PRIVATE TXT ACCESS
Lucas’s Private build must expose human-readable TXT for active AppDevRules, edenOSrules, GrandMasterRegister export, access/profile definitions, Private profile, capability contracts, Design Mantra, versioning and supersession/provenance relevant to the environment.
Machine-readable state may exist in parallel but must not be the only readable representation.

RECOVERY
RECOVER / REUSE LAST KNOWN GOOD BEFORE REDESIGN.
Do not rebuild what can be recovered, reset what can be migrated, replace what can be repaired, fork what can share a core, duplicate what can be composed, or claim verification without evidence.
